title: Baby 'cot cams' plan after inquiry finds Lucy Letby crimes could have been prevented
description: Plans will be "urgently" developed for live-streaming cameras after an inquiry report into Lucy Letby's crimes.

title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
description: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.

title: Dan Thomas resigns as Reform Wales leader after arrest on suspicion of assault
description: Thomas said he has done nothing wrong as Gwent Police confirms arrest on suspicion of assault.

title: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling admits dangerous driving on motorway before crash
description: The former England winger crashed a Lamborghini into motorway barriers in May.

title: Warning of space arms race as US confirms weapons in Earth's orbit
description: The BBC's defence correspondent Jonathan Beale explains what an arms race in space might look like - and what it could mean for us on the ground.

title: UK in talks about joining global defence bank led by Canada
description: Supporters of the scheme say the bank would enable governments to get cheaper loans to spend on defence projects.

title: Thirteenth Met Police officer sacked after Charing Cross Panorama film
description: PC Mason O'Connor is dismissed after a hearing found he had breached standards of professional behaviour, the Met said.

title: State pension likely to top £13,000 a year as UK wage growth slows to 3.9%
description: The increase has reignited the debate about the state pension's long-term affordability and generational fairness.

title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".
